description: D44 defined local finite trusted controls accepted after actual owner/native/hook/retry/cancel/HTTP/CLI/fault/related/fresh full and readonly audit gates; no general model quality or production action approval.

related.description: Actual D33-D44 related regression; new controls plus accepted components; prior first CORE sample retained; fresh full gate remains separate.

contracts: Separate default-off controls on accepted workflow; matching live native/approval dependencies and correct teardown order
Finite trusted hooks reserve before/after metadata;4 workflow/5 lineage steps;2 proposals;16/32 event caps;0 automatic retries
Exact owner progress discoverability and cancellation before first capture await; no foreign signals or queued actions
Signal/cancel and join actual model/source/native work before closing pins; preserve real before/after-commit and child-exit boundaries
Retire pending patch/check capabilities without source rollback, approval-event rewriting or fabricated checkpoint intent
Independent native writer busy intent remains pending until explicit later cleanup, retaining actual commit and pin ownership
One explicit component-free failed proposal retry derives immutable options, creates distinct record/fresh source/checkpoint/reviews and keeps first failed completion
No third/after-action/cancelled retry or old approval recovery; record/lineage costs stay charged
Known patch/check state/error/receipt/observation/persistence uncertainty survives cleanup/hook/send/caller/shutdown faults
Actual TCP and two typed CLI reviews after disclosed controlled first-invalid/second-valid inference; no model-quality claim
limitations: Process-local single-worker controls/history/grants; no durable workflow cancellation/retry authority or old-grant recovery
Only fixed server policy metadata hooks; no dynamic plugins, commands, callbacks, new model or automatic corrective action
Cancellation preserves actual committed/unknown effects; no automatic rollback or retroactive approval event revocation
Busy independent component actions require explicit later cleanup; controller shutdown alone does not revoke their authority
TCP disconnect alone is not claimed as request-task cancellation
